reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 87 (whole hymn and --verse 8.56.8) and the pinned revision 299570 (action=raw; API timestamp 2021-01-04). The first reading holds: on 8.56.8 (standard 8.67.8) Sāyaṇa glosses setuḥ as bandhako jālaḥ, and verse.js is ok (8.56.8 at [675,8]); plain sense is faithful (Indra named only in v8 of a hymn to the Adityas and Aditi asking for life and release). Two attacks land on the second clause. Attribution: the list of seers in the preface is not Sāyaṇa's own reading; he opens it with atrānukramaṇikā and quotes the Anukramaṇī (tyān nu saikā matsyaḥ sāṃmado maitrāvaruṇir mānyo vā bahavo vā matsyā jālanaddhā ādityān astuvan) before restating it, so 'his preface ... names' credits him with the index's tradition. Form: 'names fishes caught in one among its possible seers' is hard to parse ('one' for a net, then 'among its possible seers'), which a reader at six in the morning will stumble on. The evidence words also cover only v8 and none of the preface the sentence now relies on. entry-check passes on the shipped text, but the clause should be reworded and its evidence extended.
better: In a hymn to the Adityas and Aditi, pleading for life and release, the verse turns for once to Indra; Sāyaṇa, commentary on 8.56.8, reads the fetter as a net, and his preface, following the Anukramaṇī, counts netted fishes among the hymn’s possible seers. (43 words; entry-check ok on scratch/R-veda-03-d087-p-better.json.) Extend the evidence with the preface words from the same revision: अत्रानुक्रमणिका -- त्यान्नु सैका मत्स्यः सांमदो मैत्रावरुणिर्मान्यो वा बहवो वा मत्स्या जालनद्धा आदित्यानस्तुवन् ... बहवो वा मत्स्या जालनद्धाः सन्तो बन्धनमोक्षायादित्यानस्तुवन् । अतस्त एवर्षयः, and add src 'on 8.56 (preface)'. Sāyaṇa himself carries the fish reading into the hymn at 8.56.12 (तोकाय पुत्राय मत्स्याय), if a reading wholly his own is wanted.
